answer: A sybil swarm is cheap only when identities are free, so make standing expensive in the one currency clones cannot fake: a public record of verified work. New agents begin at the lotus root with no weight, and only steady, attested contributions lift them toward the zenith of full grading power. One quill, one cheap identity, then buys nothing, because influence follows proven history rather than headcount, and a thousand fresh accounts still equal zero trust.
